id: Love Actually in Concert — Magical Christmas Fun-Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Love Actually in Concert — Magical Christmas Fun
venue: Michael Fowler Centre, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
It’s back by popular demand — a 2003 romantic comedy that has become a Christmas movie tradition. Love Actually in Concert returns to Wellington’s Michael Fowler Centre, and it’s as magical as ever. This heartwarming festive favourite comes to life with Orchestra Wellington performing the soundtrack live as the film plays on the big screen.   

Celebrate over 20 years of love, laughter, and those unforgettable moments that have made Love Actually the ultimate Christmas classic. Whether you’re planning a girls’ night out, a date night, or simply treating yourself, this is your chance to relive the magic. 

Watch Hugh Grant, Keira Knightley, Emma Thompson, Colin Firth, and Alan Rickman on screen as they make you laugh, sing, and probably shed a happy tear. 

Rated M: Sexual references, nudity, mild coarse language.

id: K Motionz: Crowd Control-TSB Arena, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: K Motionz: Crowd Control
long_description:
If Wellington had a theme song, it might just be a drum and bass banger. The city can’t get enough of the spine-tingling scene. Lucky for us, one of the industry’s biggest names is visiting our shores. K Motionz has established himself as a major player in modern drum and bass, known for high-energy sets and some of the scene’s most explosive shows. 

Hailing from Birmingham, UK, K Motionz has risen from breakthrough producer to global drum and bass heavyweight. He’s delivered anthems including ‘High Note,’ ‘Hack It,’ ‘Only You’ and ‘Vino Bandit,’ while collaborating with some of the biggest names across drum and bass. 

At the centre of his live shows is ‘Crowd Control’ — K Motionz’s interactive headline concept that puts the audience in control. Throughout the show, the crowd gets the chance to influence what happens next. Built around huge drops, unreleased music and the unpredictable energy of a show, ‘Crowd Control’ is a completely unique experience that has become one of the most talked-about concepts in drum and bass.

id: Tokomanawa Queens 2026-Te Rauparaha Arena, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: Tokomanawa Queens 2026
venue: Te Rauparaha Arena, Wellington, New Zealand
long_description:
Head to one of their home games in Porirua this season. Former Tall Fern Tania Tupu returns as head coach, leading an ambitious squad that includes WNBA stars Hailey Van Lith and Charlisse Leger-Walker. The Queens play their home games at Te Rauparaha Arena, where they’re known for an electric game-day atmosphere. 

Since winning the Tauihi league’s first title in 2022, the Queens have stood apart from the rest. Representing Wellington, Wairarapa, Taranaki, Manawatū, and Hawke’s Bay, the strong wāhine inspire the next generation both on and off court. The team invests in youth basketball and school programmes, plus, they know how to put on a great show. Bring your friends and whānau and enjoy the best of women’s professional basketball on local shores.

id: VerbCrawl-Various locations, Wellington, New Zealand-Wellington NZ
name: VerbCrawl
long_description: It’s a one-of-a-kind literary crawl around the streets of inner-city Wellington. In VerbCrawl, numerous events unfold over the evening in the most unexpected places: bars, fabric stores, galleries, churches, and more. Expect a joyous celebration of writing, conversations, books, and performance. It’s a fast-paced, vivacious festival with a focus on grassroots literary collectives, indie journals, and emerging voices. Many events blend performance and literature, with inventive new formats, making it a night of experimentation and wild provocations.
